result:
Summary: The sources indicate that DRAGIN, a dynamic retrieval augmented generation framework, consists of two key components: RIND (Real-time Information Needs Detection) and QFS (Query Formulation System). RIND identifies the optimal moment to activate the retrieval module based on the LLM’s real-time information needs, while QFS crafts the appropriate query once retrieval is triggered. These components work together to decide when and what to retrieve during the text generation process of Large Language Models (LLMs).
